# BioAcq for Windows

Run `BioAcq\BioAcq.exe` and keep the `BioAcq` folder together.

- Windows 10/11 x64. Built from `main` at ca9c74b by GitHub Actions; the Visual C++ runtime is included.
- Connects the EmotiBit over Bluetooth (not yet tried with the EmotiBit on Windows). The Cyton dongle needs the FTDI driver.
- Unsigned: if SmartScreen appears, click **More info** → **Run anyway**.
- Recordings go to `Documents\BioAcq Recordings`.
